page.content:
Last companion, who returns Excalibur to the water.

How Bedivere connects

  • Weapon: Excalibur — Bedivere returns Excalibur to the water after Camlann.
  • Faction: Round Table — Bedivere is among the last knights of the Table.

What is Bedivere?

Bedivere stays with the dying Arthur, twice hides the sword, and finally casts Excalibur to the hand that rises from the lake.

Key threads lead to Excalibur and Round Table.
